text_block_list.text: I-I-I... I hope, I hope I'm not bothering you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
No need to be so formal. I should
apologize for calling you here when
you're
still settling in.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
O-oh, not at all! Um, the p-p-p-privilege is
all mine. ...No, wait, the
pleasure? U-um!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Haha... Well, I should start with an
introduction. I am Симболи Рудольф,
Tracen
Academy's student council president.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик, we warmly welcome you. If
you ever have any issues
with your student
life, please feel free to let us know.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Th-thank you! Pleased to meet you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Likewise. As you already know, Tracen
Academy is the country's
greatest learning
facility for Umamusume longing to enter
the racing
world.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Here you'll inspire and be inspired through
friendship and rivalry, find
your one and
only trainer, and battle on with frenzied
effort in the
Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I expect you to work vigorously in
achieving a bright future for
yourself.
Welcome to Академия Тайсен, Special
Week.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That said, I was hoping to offer you a tour
after our meeting, but...
unfortunately, I
have other affairs with the student council
that I must
attend to.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Which! Means! That! It's my time to shine!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Eep!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
When Prez is in trouble, I'm the one who
comes running! Me, the
venerable Tokai
Teio! Wahahahaha!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-wh-wh-where did you just come
from?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Teio... it's fine if you want to kid around,
but you could choose a
better time and
place.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Okaaay, sorry about that. ♪ Ah, you're the
new transfer student,
right? I'm Tokai
Teio, nice to meetcha! ♪
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
All right, let's get on with the tour! On
your marks, gooo!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: H-huh?! W-wait for meeee!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Goodness...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Whatever the case, I know I can trust Teio.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Right then! Let the academy tour begin!
First up, this is our classroom!
We gotta
study too, you know!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Hm... Showing you this is pretty boring,
yeah? Any old school has
classrooms.
Come on! To the next place!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Huh, already?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaaa! It's the turf track! From here on,
you'll be training on this
beauty!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Wooow, amazing! It's so well-kept and
clean!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Well, that's all thanks to the maintenance
staff! Thank you, staff, for
always
supporting us!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Okay, onto the next place!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: There's more?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Now it's time for a back-to-back marathon
through three training
facilities!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
First up is the school's gym. All the devices
were built to be used by
us Umamusume,
so going full throttle is totally okay! ♪
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
This is the pool! Being able to swim no
matter the time of year is the
best!
Incidentally, I'm especially great at diving!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
But my number one thing is dancing!
Forgetting to practice for the
winning
concerts is a big no-no, you hear?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Oh, and here, this is... Huh? New girl?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Y-yes, I'm here! Sorry to keep you waiting.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hmmm. Are you tired? Well, the academy is really spacious, and we have been running from place to place.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Weeeell... Yeah... All right, I've decided!
Now's the perfect time, too!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Let's move on to the last place in our tour!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Hey, this isn't Академия Тайсен! Why are
we at the Tokyo
Racecourse?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Come, come, no need to fret the deets!
Rather, we need to hurry up
before things
start!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: I'm talking about the G1 race, of course!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's part of the prestigious
Twinkle Series that every racer
aspires to!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Within the series, the G1 races are the
toppest of top-class! And this
one's about
to begin!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Rounding the fourth corner is number
three, Antagonist! But number
seven,
Ribbon March, holds on! Look at her
persevere!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
And here comes number ten, Ay Tanri,
from the outside! She's pulling
to the front
with incredible speed!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
200 meters to go! They're neck and neck
for the lead! It's a close one!
They're
running side by side, right up to the finish
line!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wooooow!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: (Such thunderous cheering, it's like a storm! The crowd feels so electric! )
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: So this is the Twinkle Series!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
How about that, new giiirl? Tell me what
you think of a real G1. ...Oh.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Ahaha, doesn't look like I need to ask!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I feel so energized! No, maybe it's
more like...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I want to be on that stage too! I want to
appear in the Twinkle Series
and seize my
dreams!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Mom, Mama, now that I'm here at Tracen
Academy in Tokyo, I'm
gonna give it
everything I've got!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
